_readme: Where each project is, as an official paper prints it. One row per district per project. District names are kept exactly as printed, with the paper's date, because Andhra Pradesh redrew its districts in April 2022 and again from January 2026. app/services/project_places.py decides which rows can be placed on today's districts and says why. Built from official sources only (no newspapers); see the project doc claude/project-districts-findings.md. Reviewed 19 Oct 2026.
